name: 指定した時刻の営業条件を調整する検索行
prompt:
Make a focused composition correction to the supplied first version of this Japanese search-condition row. Keep its exact copy and visual design, but remove the large blank canvas above and below.

The source row crop is the geometry authority: the component itself is extremely wide and shallow, about 6.67:1. Make the canvas a tight horizontal strip around the row. The clock, text and trailing sliders icon should occupy most of the canvas height, with only a small, even top and bottom margin (about 8-12% of the row height). Put the thin pale-gray divider just beneath the row, close to the bottom edge. Do not center a small row inside a tall or square canvas.

Preserve the exact Japanese text “10:55に営業している場所”, the left outlined clock, Lighthouse-green label and clock, and the dark two-line sliders icon at the far right. Keep the source spacing, baseline and relative icon sizes. Use a clean white background and crisp Meiryo-style Japanese text.

Do not add or remove characters, alter icon structure, change accent color, or add page headings, cards, frames, decorations or watermark. Output only the single compact row.
